description: Three units of a core frame and an extension substream whose asset has both a low bit rate (LBR) and a lossless (XLL) component.

skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg's parser names a core with an extension substream by its XLL component first (dca_parser.c) and its decoder names LBR first (dcadec.c), then sets the profile itself (dca_lbr.c), which the stub components do not allow
skip.decode: ffmpeg rejects the XLL stub, a common header followed by filler, for its missing channel set sub-header (dca_xll.c: 'Invalid XLL sub-header checksum')
